title: Latency feature extractor and contextual alert decomposer
creator: Marcus Chen
description: Problem: On-call rotations surface noisy burn-rate alerts and multi-system incidents where the initial alert signal lacks rich contextual clues (e.g., batching vs kernel/regression vs cold cache). That increases mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve. Goal: implement a "latency feature extractor" service and a downstream "contextual alert decomposer" which enriches SLO-breach/burn-rate alerts with prioritized likely root-cause candidates, a confidence score, and suggested runbook actions. The extractor will synthesize features from traces, logs, and metrics (request path, kv-cache hit rates, batch queue time, token-level latency spikes, model variant, region, and percentile deltas over multiple windows). The decomposer will run an ensemble (lightweight rules + ML scoring) to produce an ordered list of hypotheses for the oncall UI and webhook consumers. This ticket covers design, prototype, integration points (tracing hooks, metrics ingestion, logging links), dashboards to surface explainer outputs, and initial evaluation against historical incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Latency feature extractor ingests traces and emits a structured feature record for >=95% of sampled requests in staging
Contextual alert decomposer attaches a ranked list of root-cause hypotheses to burn-rate alerts in the Alerting UI with confidence scores
Attached hypothesis includes at least one actionable suggestion (runbook link / mitigation) for >=80% of alerts in the testset
End-to-end pipeline latency for enrichment is <60s for high-priority alerts (SLO burn-rate P0) in staging
Automated backfill test: on 50 curated historical incidents, the decomposer's top hypothesis matches the post-mortem dominant cause in >=65% cases
tasks: Design feature schema and protobuf for extractor records (trace+log join keys, feature vector)
Add tracing hook to runtime to emit lightweight hints (batch-size, kv-cache-hit boolean, kernel id)
Pipeline: implement a streaming transformer in Telemetry Ingest to enrich traces with recent metric snapshots
Prototype ML scoring model (gradient-boosted rules + logistic regressor) and a fall-back deterministic rule engine
Expose decomposer outputs to Alerting UI and webhook payloads; add a new 'Hypotheses' panel to incident cards
Create dashboards: hypothesis coverage, precision/recall vs historical PMs, pipeline latency SLOs
End-to-end test harness and replay job to validate against 50 historical incidents
Write runbooks for the top 6 hypothesis categories and link them in decomposer output
